checklist.name: security jobs parallelism opportunity identified

checklist.name: needs: added to lint jobs in output
checklist.description: In the optimized .gitlab-ci.yml, lint_code and lint_types have `needs: [build]` (or equivalent) so they start immediately after build

checklist.name: needs: added to security or package jobs in output

checklist.name: Critical path improvement quantified

checklist.name: needs: mechanism explained
